claim: The repo documents that an isolated Shadow of War test copy still leaked: steam.exe wrote test saves into the real Steam userdata via ISteamRemoteStorage even with Steam Cloud off, and NVIDIA App rewrote the real render.cfg.
evidence: NOTES session n: real remote save rewritten 'with the same bytes' as the sandbox save; session f: NVIDIA App rewrote render.cfg.
game_build_compatibility: Repo-reported for Steam app 356190 build 3095001, ShadowOfWar.exe 1.0.8874.0, SHA-256 ed0d95cabb033cd66aaa99d699374881846c3cb03ec345f1123d82d45e0bdaef; not checked against our install. Saves under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WB Games\Shadow of War plus Steam remote copy (repo-reported).
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Observed on one third-party machine; their fix (blocking ISteamRemoteStorage writes in-process) was not reviewed by us. Their code (sow-coop) is unpublished.
next_experiment: Before any future game launch, back up real saves and Steam userdata\<id>\356190 with a hash manifest and re-check after every run; treat store client and GPU tools as out-of-process writers.
